 Oral Judgment

This appeal is filed by the appellant/claimant under Section 173(1) of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988,
challenging the judgment and award dated 10.06.2016 passed in MVC No.330/2010 on the file of the Additional District & Sessions Judge & Member of MACT, Chamrajanagara, for enhancing the compensation.

entities.text: Additional District & Sessions Judge & Member of MACT, Chamrajanagara
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Heard the arguments of the learned counsel for the appellant and learned counsel for respondent No.2.
Notice to respondent No.1 is dispensed with.
The ranks of the parties are retained as per tribunal for the sake of convenience.
3. Before the tribunal, it was held that the driver of the vehicle has no driving license and thus the owner of NC: 2025:KHC:35231 HC-KAR the vehicle was only liable to pay the compensation.
Presently, learned counsel for the appellant stated that they obtained the driving license and requested the court to remand the matter to the tribunal for producing the same.
4. Learned counsel of the respondent No.2 objected the same on the ground that respondent No.1 has not preferred any appeal.
However, learned counsel for the appellant stated that appeal of respondent No.1 is filed, but it was dismissed for default.
Therefore, this court finds it reasonable to remand the matter to the tribunal to give an opportunity to appellant counsel to produce evidence regarding driving license.

5. The tribunal is at liberty to grant reasonable opportunity to both sides for adducing evidence and for arguments and to dispose of the matter afresh by duly NC: 2025:KHC:35231 HC-KAR considering the evidence on record, on merits within 3 months from the date of receipt of the order.
6. Further, petitioner/appellant filed their driving license, at this stage he is not entitled for interest.
7. Registry is directed to send the record immediately.
